-- Table for flagging/starring a day with an optional note, used by the new -- calendar history view. Mirrors the RLS pattern used by goals/entries/visits -- (scoped through members.user_id = auth.uid()). -- -- NOTE: member_id is TEXT here (not uuid) to match your members.id column, -- which is text-based (generated by the app's own uid() helper). create table if not exists day_flags ( id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), member_id text not null references members(id) on delete cascade, date date not null, note text, created_at timestamptz not null default now(), unique (member_id, date) ); alter table day_flags enable row level security; create policy "day_flags select own" on day_flags for select using ( member_id in (select id from members where user_id = auth.uid()) ); create policy "day_flags insert own" on day_flags for insert with check ( member_id in (select id from members where user_id = auth.uid()) ); create policy "day_flags update own" on day_flags for update using ( member_id in (select id from members where user_id = auth.uid()) ); create policy "day_flags delete own" on day_flags for delete using ( member_id in (select id from members where user_id = auth.uid()) );
